health.label: API
welcome.headline:
One sheet a day.
One version that rules.
welcome.subcopy: Every cut-off date is a snapshot of the portfolio. When the lender sends a corrected file, the new version is stored whole alongside the previous one and you choose which one counts. Nothing is overwritten and nothing changes until you confirm it.
welcome.badge.todasVigentes: {n} cut-off dates, all with a current version
welcome.diagram.title: How a sheet travels
console.ruler.title: Cut-off dates
console.ruler.empty: No sheet has been uploaded yet.
console.firstRun.title: No sheet has been uploaded yet.
console.firstRun.body: Upload the day's sheet and choose its cut-off date. Every file is kept as a version of that date: it is validated, normalised, and every issue it carries is reported back to you.
console.offline.title: No connection to the API
console.offline.body: The backend could not be reached, so nothing can be listed or uploaded. Check that it is running and try again.
console.upload.title: Upload a sheet
console.upload.intro: Every file you upload creates a new version of its cut-off date. An existing version is never overwritten.
console.upload.sheet.hint: The worksheet holding the cut-off data.
console.upload.error.tooBig: The file is over the 64 MB maximum.
console.upload.error.date: State the cut-off date this sheet represents.
console.upload.error.network: Could not reach the API. Check that the backend is running.
console.duplicate.title: This file was uploaded before
console.duplicate.body: The file is identical to version {versiones} of the same date. The new version was registered anyway and is being processed.
console.progress.title: Processing version {version}
console.progress.hint: This takes a few seconds. Carry on working; we'll tell you when it ends.
console.day.title: Versions of {fecha}
console.day.empty.title: This day has no versions.
console.day.empty.body: Upload this date's sheet to get started.
console.day.noVigente: This date has no current version. Nothing calculated over the portfolio takes it into account.
console.summary.title: Version summary
console.summary.pending: The summary appears once processing ends.
console.incidencias.title: Issues
console.incidencias.empty: This version has no issues of that severity.
console.incidencias.emptyAll: This version was processed without a single issue.
console.vigente.title: Which version counts for {fecha}?
console.vigente.intro: Version {nueva} finished processing and this date already had a current version. Choose which one counts from here on.
console.vigente.keepNote: Nothing changes. This is the preselected option.
console.vigente.replaceNote: Portfolio, history and metrics are recalculated over this version.
console.vigente.formatChanged: This version's format differs from the current one.
console.setVigente.title: Change the current version
console.setVigente.body: Version {version} becomes the current version of {fecha}. Everything calculated over the portfolio — history, presence and metrics — will be read from it.
console.setVigente.error409: Only a finished version can be the current one.
console.delete.title: Delete version {version}
console.delete.body: Its rows, its issues and the original file are erased. An audit record with no sheet data remains. This cannot be undone.
console.delete.vigenteWarning: This is the current version of {fecha}.
console.delete.vigenteChoice: I confirm that {fecha} is left with no current version
console.delete.vigenteChoiceNote: While the date has no current version, that day counts for neither the portfolio nor the metrics.
console.delete.vigenteAlternative: You can also make another version of this date current before deleting.
console.delete.needsConfirm: Tick the box to confirm the date is left with no current version.
common.errorBody: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
incidencia.cabecera_desconocida: Unrecognised header; the column was not catalogued
incidencia.cabecera_duplicada: The header appears more than once
incidencia.columna_faltante: Expected column missing from the file
incidencia.clave_no_texto: The promissory-note key is not valid text
incidencia.pagare_repetido: Key repeated in the file; the first occurrence was kept
incidencia.pagare_duplicado_distinto: The key repeats with different data
incidencia.documento_formato_invalido: The document is neither an integer nor text
incidencia.documento_solo_ceros: Document made up of zeros only
incidencia.ruc_invalido: 11-digit RUC with an invalid prefix or check digit
incidencia.dni_completado_con_ceros: DNI padded to 8 digits with leading zeros
incidencia.fecha_invalida: Could not be read as a date
incidencia.vencimiento_operativo_vacio: Expected NO or a date; arrived empty
incidencia.cuotas_inconsistentes: Paid plus pending do not add up to approved
incidencia.dias_atraso_difiere_entidad: Days overdue differ from the lender's figure
mowaMes.config.title: MOWA MES settings
mowaMes.config.intro: What every campaign starts from. Each block saves on its own.
mowaMes.plataforma.title: Platform
mowaMes.plataforma.limite.hint: {n} SMS per calendar month, counting products and supervision.
mowaMes.plataforma.limite.rango: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
mowaMes.plataforma.whatsapp.hint: A 9-digit number. The speech turns it into https://wa.me/+51 followed by the number.
mowaMes.plataforma.whatsapp.invalido: The WhatsApp number is not valid.
mowaMes.plataforma.sinWhatsapp: Without a contact WhatsApp, the speech segments that use it cannot be generated.
mowaMes.supervisores.title: Default supervisors
mowaMes.supervisores.vacio: No supervisors are configured. Without supervisors no campaign can be created.
mowaMes.supervisores.procedencias.hint: Documents are numbered from 00000001: first those of the first origin, then those of the next.
mowaMes.supervisores.ninguno: There are no supervisors in the list yet.
mowaMes.supervisores.documentosPendiente: There are unsaved changes: documents are reassigned on save.
mowaMes.supervisores.problema.procedenci: Origin {n} repeats a name already in the list.
Supervisor {n} has an origin that is no longer in the list.
mowaMes.speech.title: Speech by segment
mowaMes.speech.inmutable.original: The original speech is never modified. Your changes are saved as a new version based on it.
mowaMes.speech.inmutable.usada: A campaign already used this version, so it is not modified. Your changes are saved as a new version based on it.
mowaMes.speech.faltaWhatsapp: The contact WhatsApp is missing and some segments use [whatsapp]: they cannot be generated until it is set under Platform.
mowaMes.speech.problemas: The API does not accept these parts:
mowaMes.speech.estructura: Message = holder (8 characters) + part 1 + instalment due date (dd/mm/yyyy) + part 2. Write [whatsapp] where the link goes. Leading and trailing spaces count.
mowaMes.speech.sinEjemplo: No example: the contact WhatsApp is missing.
mowaMes.speech.calculo: Length computed with an 8-character holder, a 10-character date and the WhatsApp link. A warning from {advertencia}, excluded from {maximo}.
mowaMes.speech.nombre.automatico: Empty: it will be named Speech N
mowaMes.speech.cambiosPendientes: This version has unsaved changes. Save or discard them before switching versions.
mowaMes.speech.error.nombreRepetido: A version with that name already exists. Choose another.
mowaMes.speech.error.usada: This version can no longer be modified. Save your changes as a new version.
mowaMes.calendario.title: Working-day calendar
mowaMes.calendario.intro: Working days run Monday to Friday, without holidays. Statutory holidays are computed automatically; here you record decreed non-working days and holidays that do not apply in a given year.
mowaMes.calendario.vacio: This year has no non-working days recorded.
mowaMes.calendario.accion.retirar.aria: Withdraw the holiday on {fecha} this year
mowaMes.calendario.dialogo.agregarIntro: A day decreed non-working stops being a working day, like a holiday.
mowaMes.calendario.dialogo.retirarIntro: That day becomes a working day again for this year only. The holiday stays in the law and you can restore it.
mowaMes.calendario.error.repetida: That date already has an exception recorded.
mowaMes.codigo.telefono_invalido: No valid phone: missing, or not 9 digits starting with 9.
mowaMes.codigo.sin_speech: No speech: its adjusted days past due exceed 120, or it has no days past due.
mowaMes.codigo.falta_titular: The holder is missing, and the message needs it.
mowaMes.codigo.falta_vencimiento: The instalment due date is missing, and the message needs it.
mowaMes.codigo.mensaje_excede_160: The message is longer than 160 characters: it does not fit in one SMS and is excluded.
mowaMes.codigo.mensaje_excede_150: The message is longer than 150 characters: it is loaded, but the speech should be shortened.
mowaMes.codigo.limite_mensual_excedido: The campaign would exceed the monthly SMS limit: creating it requires confirmation.
mowaMes.speech.resumen.ok: Every segment fits in one SMS.
mowaMes.speech.resumen.falta_whatsapp.un: 1 segment cannot be generated without WhatsApp.
mowaMes.speech.resumen.falta_whatsapp: {n} segments cannot be generated without WhatsApp.
